name: 3 Layer Dish Drainer Rack Stainless Steel
description:
Kitchen Dish Cup Drying Rack – Chrome Finish

Material & Build: Sturdy construction with chrome finish; strong and durable due to precision rolling process

Design: Space-saving, multi-tier design with removable tray and flatware holder

Usage:

Top tier for plates

Bottom tier for saucers, cups, and bowls

Side rack for glasses

Flatware holder for utensils

Hygienic Feature: Waterspout ensures dishes remain clean and hygienic

Dimensions: 21.7" × 10" × 20.4" (L × W × H)

Package Includes: 1 Dish Rack with two trays

Versatile Use: Suitable for home kitchens, campers, dorms, and more

Quality Assurance: 100% brand new, inspected before shipment

Description:
Organize and dry your kitchenware efficiently with this sturdy, chrome-finished dish rack. Its multi-tier design maximizes space while keeping dishes, cups, and utensils clean and hygienic. Perfect for any home or portable kitchen setup.
